label: Lausanne 3T TOF-MRA vessels (VesselBoost)
description: Binary cerebral vessel segmentation produced by VesselBoost (manual_0429) on a 192 x 192 x 64 crop of the CC0 Lausanne 3T TOF-MRA scan (0.47 x 0.47 x 0.70 mm, 14 KB).
expectedResult: Interactive 3D diameter-coloured vessel tree, per-segment and per-junction CSV tables, diameter map NIfTI, and global morphometry report (~965 mm total length, ~111 segments).

label: Bollmann et al. 7T 140 µm pial arteries (eLife)
description: Native 140 µm isotropic 7T TOF-MRA human pial artery segmentation crop (256 x 256 x 140, Subject 02, 49 KB) from Bollmann et al. (2022, eLife).
expectedResult: High-resolution 3D diameter-coloured pial arterial tree, per-segment and per-junction CSV tables, diameter map NIfTI, and global morphometry report (~1110 mm total length, ~622 segments, ~0.27 mm median diameter).
